target: FDIC certificate failure within the next calendar year, with nonfailure closure/insurance exit as a competing nonfailure outcome; not borrower default or IFRS9 PD
annual_anchor: December 31 report, assumed usable on following April 1; prediction interval (April 1, next April 1]
availability_limitation: Three-month availability lag is a research assumption; current historical revisions are not reconstructed. This is retrospective temporal evaluation, not point-in-time prospective performance.
missingness: Training-only median imputation and training-only robust scaling for logistic models; gradient boosting uses native missing-value routing. Reject entirely missing development features.
model_selection: Minimum unweighted log loss on selection years; three candidates per full model, equal development rows; no model refit on later partitions
calibration: Separate calibration year, weakly regularized logistic mapping of probability logits, nonnegative slope; report raw and calibrated probabilities

policy.purpose: Illustrative monitoring cost, not measured financial loss or deployment utility

capacity_diagnostic: At most the highest ceil(1% of banks) scores per annual test cohort; report actual counts and zero-failure cohorts
primary_comparison: Calibrated gradient boosting minus calibrated full logistic; AUC, average precision, Brier, log loss, illustrative monitoring cost

uncertainty.method: Separate paired cluster percentile intervals; no iid-row uncertainty or joint-dependence claim

source_access: Official public FDIC BankFind API; no registration, no credential use; complete pagination and snapshot-index/row-key checks
source_probes_before_registration: API/schema checks inspected two 2023 report rows and one 2000 development row, plus documented fields and metadata; no model predictions, final outcomes, or performance statistics were examined.
stop_rules: Do not modify frozen test years, features, models or policies after scores are observed
Retain negative findings and all final test cohorts
Publish only the registered target, revision/availability and population limitations
